prototype.capture: DXF addHelix constructs the existing spline representation and retains a deep-copied DRW_Helix plus its entity. After import operations execute, the carrier binds to the final document entity only if all modeled spline geometry agrees.
prototype.admission: During save only the exact bound object, same source/target revision AC1021+ and exact spline geometry can replay a HELIX. Known HELIX XDATA, app data, reactors, extension dictionary, proxy cache, selected unmodeled visual attributes and preserved object/entity/section/root entries cause atomic finalizer refusal. Different source/target revision also refuses; modified or replaced spline objects continue the existing SPLINE behavior. The current scratch prototype refuses unchanged HELIX replay by default because whole-file graph closure is unproved. P8_HELIX_EXPERIMENTAL_PARTIAL_CENSUS=1 bypasses that refusal solely for scratch experiments; this unsafe escape must never ship.
prototype.limits: The listed checks do not establish absence or closure of inbound references from other modeled source records or early DXF sections; this is the observed blocking defect. The source handle is not passed through the consumer attribute adapter.
prototype.entitiesFacet: The scratch consumer opts into DRW_DxfEntitiesSourceHandler and conservatively checks raw physical ENTITIES reference-coded fields against retained HELIX source handles. In the two-entity LINE/XDATA reproduction it observes complete=1 and inbound=1 and refuses the write. This is an ENTITIES-only experiment and does not establish a complete source graph.
prototype.sectionFacetExperiments: The scratch consumer also collects selected reference-coded values from per-BLOCK children and LAYER/APPID namespace source rows, and observes identity candidate transport. Locally authored BLOCK LINE and LAYER XDATA 1005 -> source HELIX each cause atomic refusal under the intentionally incomplete experimental mode. No claim is made that all blocks, rows, callbacks or roles were covered.

validation.positiveResult: 3/3 pass. Same-version ASCII/binary output retains a HELIX with source-specific axis/radius/turns/height/handedness and spline control values; standalone typed libdxfrw readback verifies both output encodings. A moved same-ID spline, identical same-ID replacement, and same-ID color edit export SPLINE; deletion emits no HELIX; source version change and direct HELIX XDATA/1005 refuse atomically. Final layer binding accounts for importer layer-resolution cloning.
validation.expectedFailure: 1/1 fails as intended: a second modeled LINE containing XDATA 1005 -> source HELIX 0x33 imports, yet save returns success instead of refusing; the line XDATA is discarded and the HELIX is emitted as handle 0x55. Thus source inbound reference is not preserved or remapped. The test is deliberately negative and remains scratch-only.
validation.inboundReaderVerification: A separate libdxfrw typed reader imported the locally authored two-entity input and verified the LINE callback retains group-1005 string 33 while the HELIX callback reports source handle 0x33. It exited 0. Thus the reference exists in the typed input callback before LibreCAD_3 discards it.
validation.facetResult: After adding the physical ENTITIES facet guard, 4/4 focused tests pass. The former inbound LINE XDATA negative now causes atomic refusal and the sentinel survives; trace reports complete=1 inbound=1. ASCII/binary unchanged HELIX, same-ID geometry/replacement/attribute changes, deletion, different-version refusal, and direct HELIX XDATA refusal remain covered.
validation.partialCensusResult: 6/6 pass in intentionally unsafe research mode. Inbound XDATA 1005 -> HELIX handle 0x33 from a physical BLOCK LINE and a selected LAYER row are observed and cause atomic refusal with destination sentinel retained; earlier ENTITIES, identity/edit/version, direct XDATA and positive profile controls also pass. The positive tests do not establish whole-file graph closure.
validation.headerResult: An independently inserted custom HEADER variable with 1005 -> 33 demonstrates the gap: default fail-closed mode passes 1/1 and preserves the destination sentinel; setting P8_HELIX_EXPERIMENTAL_PARTIAL_CENSUS=1 makes the refusal assertion fail because save succeeds despite reported ENTITIES and identity transport completion. This is an expected negative experiment, not successful preservation.

facilityAudit.typedCapture: dxfRW::processLine and processHelix publish typed callbacks; ordinary LINE is not supplied to addRawDxfEntity. The consumer addLine reconstructs a line without saving DRW_Entity::extData.
facilityAudit.outboundMapping: dxfRW::writeEntity can capture a nonzero source handle and records sourceHandleToMintedMap, which remapObjectHandle can consult after emission. LibreCAD_3 getEntityAttributes does not supply a source handle to its reconstructed entity.
facilityAudit.callerMapping: setHandleRemap and setReferenceResolver can map selected references; addDxfWriteHandleRemap is scoped to writeBlocks. The consumer currently sets a remap for selected preserved raw-object identities, not all typed source-entity handles.
facilityAudit.inspection: setDxfEntitySectionsWriteInspector examines staged emitted BLOCKS/ENTITIES output, and header/tables/objects inspectors inspect staged output. These are valuable output checks but do not collect unknown or dropped references from typed source records; write-order also means early HEADER/TABLES references require a planned target before entity emission.
facilityAudit.entitiesPhysicalFacet: DRW_DxfEntitiesSourceHandler offers bounded physical ENTITIES records and scalar values even for modeled records, including 1005; DRW_DxfEntitiesDeliveryHandler can associate returned callback events to physical origin. Complete denotes transport to ENDSEC only, and quota/allocation/boundary states, later whole-read failure, semantic scope, duplicates, ownership and role validation must be checked explicitly.
facilityAudit.blockPhysicalFacet: DRW_DxfBlockChildrenSourceHandler and DRW_DxfBlockDeliveryHandler offer per-BLOCK physical children and delivery events; all blocks, callbacks and ownership paths must be joined and bounded. In the one-block reference test the physical facet reports has33=1 and the guard refuses, but seen status does not establish a complete block inventory or source-to-delivery pairing.
facilityAudit.identityFacet: DRW_DxfIdentitySourceHandler offers document-wide physical code 5/105 candidate and parser-admission information, including opaque-scope distinctions, but it is not a census of all references or proof of whole-import success. The sampled complete=1 records=26 sections=6 is identity-candidate transport only and missed the HEADER reference, as expected.
facilityAudit.otherSections: Selective TABLE/SYMBOL/OBJECT source facets and staged output inspectors can assist, but the examined interface does not provide one complete role-aware inbound reference census for HEADER, TABLES, OBJECTS and unmodeled scopes. Do not infer absence of references from an ENTITIES-only report.
facilityAudit.namespacePhysicalFacet: DRW_DxfNamespaceSourceHandler exposes selected physical LAYER/APPID rows. In the generated LAYER 1005 test it reports has33=1 and the guard refuses. This is not a census of all TABLES records, unknown table data, delivery pairing or edge roles.

nextImplementation: Retain a unique import-generation/frame-bound source handle and entity lineage through layer-resolution replacement, edits, deletion and cloning.

Build a complete source-reference census across HEADER, TABLES, BLOCKS, ENTITIES and OBJECTS, including typed and raw records, XDATA 1005, owners, reactors, dictionaries and opaque or unsupported variants; classify unknown and unresolved edges as failure, not absent references.
Plan and reserve source-to-emitted identities before early section emission; apply target-role-aware remapping and inspect staged output plus fresh readback for every retained edge.

Reject ambiguous, missing, stale-generation, unrepresentable, or unremappable graphs atomically; retry correctly. Exercise source HELIX outbound XDATA, inbound LINE XDATA, raw object references, early HEADER/TABLE references, collisions, duplicate IDs and source version changes in ASCII and binary.

Choose explicit behavior for changed same-ID geometry, nongeometry edits, copies, deletion and undo/redo; demonstrate lineage, report any deliberate metadata loss to users, and qualify both LibreCAD consumers.
limitations: A scratch prototype and generated inputs are not committed to LibreCAD_3 or libdxfrw.
Positive results apply only to the tested locally generated profile; the negative incoming-reference test prevents support promotion.
No native HELIX geometry evaluation, full source graph, binary ABI, GUI, Linux or Windows qualification.
The scratch physical ENTITIES facet is enabled for every DXF import and can add collection cost; no performance, quota, multiple-section or successful whole-read safety qualification is established.
The experimental partial-census environment switch is unsafe and scratch-only. Default HELIX replay refuses pending a complete source census and handle plan; no prototype is ready to publish.
BLOCKS and selected LAYER cases do not prove inventory completeness, source/delivery pairing, allocation or quota behavior, multiple sections, edge roles, or whole-read success.
